prompt:
Production game asset: an isolated animal landmark for a sophisticated all-ages watercolor storybook island. Fine warm pencil/ink contours and hand-painted watercolor textures, sage foliage, warm terracotta timber, cream stone, soft natural daylight, charming believable miniatures. Friendly animal actively using its habitat. High three-quarter isometric camera, entire building, animal and small oval grass/earth foundation fully visible with generous transparent margins. Square canvas; crisp silhouette readable as a 150px map marker; centered, fills 75 percent of image. Truly transparent background, no backdrop, no lettering, no numbers, no UI, no frame, no glossy 3D, no giant symbols. Keep same architecture and animal identity across five growth stages; each higher stage visibly develops the same home.
LOCATION: Panda Rescue Station. GROWTH STAGE 5 of 5.
CONTENT: a refined bustling woodland travel station with two coordinated wings, elegant clock tower, full platform and gardens, panda welcoming several animal passengers.
Only one single coherent landmark illustration, not multiple stages or a sheet.
